sqlMap.select: SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME, 'LIVE' AS SOURCE FROM CUSTOMER C WHERE C.STATUS = #status# UNION ALL SELECT A.CUSTOMER_ID, A.CUSTOMER_NAME, 'ARCHIVE' AS SOURCE FROM ARCHIVED_CUSTOMER A WHERE A.STATUS = #status#
SELECT ORDER_ID, 'ONLINE' AS CHANNEL FROM ONLINE_ORDER UNION ALL SELECT ORDER_ID, 'OFFLINE' AS CHANNEL FROM OFFLINE_ORDER UNION SELECT ORDER_ID, 'RETURN' AS CHANNEL FROM RETURN_ORDER

WITH RECENT_ORDER AS ( SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.CUSTOMER_ID, O.TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.ORDER_DATE >= #since# ) SELECT R.CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(R.TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS RECENT_TOTAL FROM RECENT_ORDER R GROUP BY R.CUSTOMER_ID

WITH RECENT_ORDER AS ( SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.CUSTOMER_ID FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.ORDER_DATE >= #since# ), RECENT_DETAIL AS ( SELECT OD.ORDER_ID, OD.PRODUCT_ID, OD.QUANTITY FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD INNER JOIN RECENT_ORDER R ON R.ORDER_ID = OD.ORDER_ID ) SELECT D.PRODUCT_ID, SUM(D.QUANTITY) AS UNITS FROM RECENT_DETAIL D GROUP BY D.PRODUCT_ID

SELECT T1.CUSTOMER_ID, T1.AMOUNT FROM (SELECT PM.CUSTOMER_ID, PM.PAYMENT_AMOUNT AS AMOUNT FROM PAYMENT PM) T1 UNION ALL SELECT T2.CUSTOMER_ID, T2.AMOUNT FROM (SELECT RF.CUSTOMER_ID, RF.REFUND_AMOUNT AS AMOUNT FROM REFUND RF) T2
